dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY-based screen/SPA architecture typical of ORCA
evidence: no EXEC CICS / no EXEC SQL / no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software — business-selection menu screen (業務選択 M01N component)
purpose.summary: This program is the business-selection menu screen (component ORCGM01N / M01N) of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt system. It handles screen initialization, navigation events (LINK/PUTG/CLICKED/entry), master-update job management, print-delete processing, and exclusive-lock control via sub-program calls. It acts as the main menu dispatcher routing users to various subsystems (patient management, billing, statistics, etc.).

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY books (37 COPY statements) for SPA/screen/master areas
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
CALL to ORCSLOCK (exclusive lock), ORCSJOB (job management), ORCSMCNDATE, etc.
Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT dispatch pattern
No EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COMP-3
SPA (Scratch Pad Area) architecture typical of ORCA/MCP framework
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP; decoded as latin-1 causing Japanese comment text to appear as mojibake. The program_type is listed as online-cics but actually uses the ORCA MCP (Medical Care Platform) screen framework, not CICS — closest enum match is online-cics. All four COBOL divisions are present. Source is fixed-format with max line length 80.
